name: Class galaxy
summary: A big group drawn as clusters of member dots by dorm or major, with your friends placed in theirs.
useWhen: a large group (a class, a club, a dorm) wants to see who is where
'which dorm is everyone in', 'who else is CS', 'find people from my floor'
dontUseWhen: a small chat with no wider membership (use a poll)
picking a time or a place to meet

members.description: Total members of the group, e.g. 6200

lenses.description: 1 or 2 ways to cluster ('By dorm', 'By major'), each with 1 to 5 groups and member counts

people.description: Chat members and their group label per lens
